title: Which Egg Has the Prize Inside?
youtube_description:
Can you guess which egg has the hidden treasure inside? Watch to find out! 🐣✨ Come back tomorrow for Level 2!

#Shorts #KidsVideo #GuessingGame #Kidify #FunForKids #EggHunt #Puzzle #Quiz

scenes.narration: One of these eggs hides a GOLDEN STAR inside — but which one?
You've got THREE choices — the red egg, the blue egg, or the purple egg!
scenes.visual_prompt: red blue purple Easter eggs row

scenes.narration: Pick your egg right now! The countdown is starting!
The RED egg — let's crack it open! Aww, just a rubber worm. Not this one!
The PURPLE egg — ooh, so close! But it's only a tiny bouncy ball. Almost!
scenes.visual_prompt: cracked purple Easter egg bouncy ball

scenes.narration: That means the BLUE egg had it all along! Pop it open — there's the golden star! Amazing!
scenes.visual_prompt: golden star inside blue Easter egg

scenes.narration: Did you get it right? Level 2 is coming tomorrow — don't miss it!
